+91 9037196319

CORE COMPETENCIES

DevOps Architecture & Platform Engineering

Cloud Strategy, Migration & Multi-Cloud Deployments

CI/CD Pipeline Design & Release Automation

Infrastructure as Code

Kubernetes & Container Orchestration

Database Platform Engineering

Observability, Monitoring & Production Reliability

Automation Engineering & Toolchain Integration

Incident, Change & Service Management

Agile Delivery, Technical Leadership & Mentorship

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) Mahatma Gandhi University — 2011

COURSES

MCSA Windows server 2012

Microsoft Azure Specialist

IBM Cloud advocate

Tino Joseph

PROFILE SUMMARY

Enterprise DevOps and Platform Architect with over 14 years of experience in shaping cloud-native, database-centric platforms and governing end-to-end delivery for highly available, production-critical systems.

Deep specialization in multi-cloud architecture and large-scale cloud migrations, delivering resilient platforms across AWS, Microsoft Azure, IBM Cloud, and GCP with strong emphasis on operational stability and scalability.

Architect of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and Kubernetes-based platforms, enabling standardized, automated, and repeatable deployments across complex enterprise environments. Strong engineering focus on production reliability, observability, and incident governance, integrating monitoring, automation, and ITSM practices to support always-on systems.



Technical leader driving platform modernization and DevOps transformation, aligning engineering execution with product and cloud strategy while maintaining hands-on involvement in automation and tooling.

WORK EXPERIENCE

DevOps Architect & Technical Manager IBM | Jul 2021 – Present

Owned end-to-end architecture, engineering delivery, and cloud enablement for IBM Db2 Warehouse (DB2W) across product development and enterprise deployments.

Led and managed DB2W engineering teams, providing technical direction and aligning delivery with Product Management and platform roadmaps.

Architected and delivered multi-cloud DB2W solutions on IBM Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, ensuring high availability, scalability, and operational stability.  Drove on-premises to cloud migrations for database platforms, managing design, execution, and production readiness.

Established Infrastructure as Code standards using ARM, JSON, YAML, and Ansible, enabling consistent and automated environment provisioning.

Designed & governed Kubernetes platforms supporting database and cloud-native

workloads.

Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and IBM UrbanCode Deploy,



automating deployments, upgrades, and rollbacks through Ansible Playbooks. Implemented monitoring and observability using CloudWatch, Azure Application Insights, AppDynamics, Grafana, Prometheus, and Sysdig.

Managed incident management and production support via ServiceNow, including root cause analysis and corrective actions.

Managed incident management and production support via ServiceNow, including root cause analysis and corrective actions.

Delivered hands-on automation and tooling using Python and Go, and maintain technical documentation using Git, Markdown, and SharePoint.

Senior DevOps Engineer Wipro | Sep 2018 – Jul 2021



Supported and enhanced enterprise DevOps platforms using AWS, Artifactory, and Jenkins.

 Deployed and managed applications and resources in AWS environments.  Automated platform and deployment workflow using Python and Ansible.  Designed and improved CI/CD pipelines, reducing deployment timelines.  Mentored onshore and offshore teams, ensuring adherence to Agile and DevOps

practices.

IT SKILLS

 Programming & Scripting:

Python | Go | Golang  Cloud Platforms: AWS |

Microsoft Azure | IBM Cloud | GCP

Kubernetes | Docker  CI/CD & Automation: Jenkins |



IBM UrbanCode Deploy (UDeploy) | Ansible | Ansible Playbooks Infrastructure as Code: ARM Templates | JSON | YAML | Terraform

Databases: IBM Db2 Warehouse (DB2W) | SQL | SQL Server  Monitoring & Observability: AWS CloudWatch | Azure Application Insights | AppDynamics | Grafana | Prometheus | Sysdig ServiceNow

 Data, AI & ML: NLP | Deep

Learning | TensorFlow | PyTorch | NumPy | Databricks | ETL | AIML

Git | Markdown | SharePoint  Power BI  VMware

Cloud Lead Consultant EY | Jan 2017 – Nov 2018

Designed and implemented cloud infrastructure solutions using Microsoft Azure

and VMware.

Managed cloud resource deployments and managed services operations.  Collaborated with cross-functional teams to strengthen cloud standards and practices.

IT Analyst Accenture | Aug 2015 – Jan 2017

Managed SQL Server databases, ensuring performance, security, and high availability.  Executed database migrations and high-availability implementations.  Built monitoring and automated reporting for resource utilization.

Systems Engineer UST Global | Sep 2011 – Aug 2015

Worked on software engineering and system administration initiatives involving

network protocols and infrastructure support.

Contributed to Agile development environments and operational troubleshooting.  Supported system stability through issue resolution and maintenance activities.

sections.text:
PROFILE SUMMARY
Enterprise DevOps and Platform Architect with over 14 years of experience in shaping cloud-native, database-centric platforms and governing end-to-end delivery for highly available, production-critical systems.
Deep specialization in multi-cloud architecture and large-scale cloud migrations, delivering resilient platforms across AWS, Microsoft Azure, IBM Cloud, and GCP with strong emphasis on operational stability and scalability.
enabling standardized, automated, and repeatable deployments across complex enterprise environments. Strong engineering focus on production reliability, observability, and incident governance, integrating monitoring, automation, and ITSM practices to support always-on systems.

Technical leader driving platform modernization and DevOps transformation, aligning engineering execution with product and cloud strategy while maintaining hands-on involvement in automation and tooling.

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
WORK EXPERIENCE
DevOps Architect & Technical Manager IBM | Jul 2021 – Present
Owned end-to-end architecture, engineering delivery, and cloud enablement for IBM Db2 Warehouse (DB2W) across product development and enterprise deployments.
Led and managed DB2W engineering teams, providing technical direction and aligning delivery with Product Management and platform roadmaps.
Architected and delivered multi-cloud DB2W solutions on IBM Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, ensuring high availability, scalability, and operational stability.  Drove on-premises to cloud migrations for database platforms, managing design, execution, and production readiness.
enabling consistent and automated environment provisioning.
Designed & governed Kubernetes platforms supporting database and cloud-native
workloads.
Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and IBM UrbanCode Deploy,

automating deployments, upgrades, and rollbacks through Ansible Playbooks. Implemented monitoring and observability using CloudWatch, Azure Application Insights, AppDynamics, Grafana, Prometheus, and Sysdig.
Managed incident management and production support via ServiceNow, including root cause analysis and corrective actions.
Managed incident management and production support via ServiceNow, including root cause analysis and corrective actions.
Delivered hands-on automation and tooling using Python and Go, and maintain technical documentation using Git, Markdown, and SharePoint.
Senior DevOps Engineer Wipro | Sep 2018 – Jul 2021

Supported and enhanced enterprise DevOps platforms using AWS, Artifactory, and Jenkins.
 Deployed and managed applications and resources in AWS environments.  Automated platform and deployment workflow using Python and Ansible.  Designed and improved CI/CD pipelines, reducing deployment timelines.  Mentored onshore and offshore teams, ensuring adherence to Agile and DevOps
practices.
Cloud Lead Consultant EY | Jan 2017 – Nov 2018
Designed and implemented cloud infrastructure solutions using Microsoft Azure
and VMware.
Managed cloud resource deployments and managed services operations.  Collaborated with cross-functional teams to strengthen cloud standards and practices.
IT Analyst Accenture | Aug 2015 – Jan 2017
Managed SQL Server databases, ensuring performance, security, and high availability.  Executed database migrations and high-availability implementations.  Built monitoring and automated reporting for resource utilization.
Systems Engineer UST Global | Sep 2011 – Aug 2015
Worked on software engineering and system administration initiatives involving
network protocols and infrastructure support.
Contributed to Agile development environments and operational troubleshooting.  Supported system stability through issue resolution and maintenance activities.
